units.source_text: 我從未這樣喝過酒，一杯接一杯地喝乾再續，續了再幹，直到喝得天昏地暗，

en.t: I had never drunk like that before, emptying one cup after another and having it refilled, then draining it again, until I was reeling in a drunken haze,

units.source_text: 我與常子面面相覷，互相苦澀地微笑。

en.t: Tsuneko and I looked at each other and exchanged bitter smiles.

units.source_text: 經堀木這麼一說，她確實是一個疲憊而窮酸的女人，

en.t: Once Horiki put it that way, she did indeed seem like a worn-out, shabby woman,

units.source_text: 心裡這麼想的同時，一種同是窮人的親近感

en.t: and at the very moment I thought this, a feeling of closeness as fellow poor people

units.source_text: 湧上心頭（我至今也這麼認為，貧富之間的矛盾或許已顯陳腐，但仍是劇本永恆的主題之一），

en.t: rose in my heart (even now I think that the conflict between rich and poor may seem worn-out, but it is still one of drama's eternal themes),

units.source_text: 此時的常子是如此的可愛，

en.t: and at that moment Tsuneko seemed so dear to me,

units.source_text: 有生以來第一次感覺到一種積極主動的、微弱的戀情在心中蠕動。

en.t: that for the first time in my life I felt a faint, active stirring of love move inside my heart.
I vomited, and kept vomiting until I lost consciousness,

units.source_text: 醉得如此失態，於我還是第一次。

en.t: and it was the first time I had ever drunk myself into such a disgraceful state.

units.source_text: 醒來時，枕頭邊坐著常子。

en.t: When I woke up, Tsuneko was sitting by my pillow.
